title: On generating text from pretrained models

cues.en: You already know how to tokenize text and generate text from a model using the generate method.
cues.zh: 你已知道如何斷詞，以及使用 generate 產生文字。

cues.en: However, the models that you can download from Huggingface have some specific settings and parameters
cues.zh: 但 Hugging Face 能下載的模型，有些特定設定、參數，

cues.en: and can give warning messages for certain inputs or lack of inputs.
cues.zh: 某些輸入，或缺少輸入時，會產生警告。

cues.en: And so this video is a short code demo, where I will just take a few minutes to explore the parameters of the tokenizer and pre-trained models.
cues.zh: 這支短程式示範，會花幾分鐘探索 tokenizer、預訓練模型的參數。

cues.en: Keep in mind that the exact syntax for interacting with models varies across different models, different tokenizers, different organizations, and so on.
cues.zh: 記得，不同模型、tokenizer、組織，互動語法不同。

cues.en: So just keep in mind that the exact naming conventions might be different for, for example, GPT and Bert.
cues.zh: 例如 GPT 與 BERT，確切命名慣例可能不同。

cues.en: So in this video I will focus on GPT two.
There is a special token called a Pad token, which is used when you have sequences in a batch that have different lengths.
cues.zh: 有個特殊詞元 pad token，用於同一批次內序列長度不同的情況。

cues.en: For example, imagine that you have sentence one sentence of ten tokens, and then the next sentence in the batch has 15 tokens.
cues.zh: 例如一句十個詞元，下一句十五個。

cues.en: Now the batches are organized as tensors or matrices in this case, and so every row needs to have exactly the same number of elements in it.
cues.zh: 批次在這裡是張量、矩陣，所以每列元素數必須相同。

cues.en: And so you would pad the shorter sequences to get up to the length of the longest sequence.
cues.zh: 就把較短序列補到最長序列的長度。

cues.en: Now the GPT two tokenizer does not have a default padding token set.
cues.zh: GPT-2 tokenizer 沒有預設填補詞元。

cues.en: And to be honest, I don't know why that is, but it's no big deal.
cues.zh: 老實說不知道原因，但沒關係。

cues.en: It's just one line of code to set a padding token, which is what you'll see here.
cues.zh: 一行程式就能設定，這裡會看到。

cues.en: Oftentimes the padding token is set to EOS, which stands for end of sequence.
cues.zh: 常把填補詞元設為 EOS，代表 end of sequence。

cues.en: That's usually used for the end of a piece of text, like the end of a Wikipedia page.
cues.zh: 通常用在文字末尾，例如維基百科頁面結尾。

cues.en: When the model is trained on iOS, it will learn that this token corresponds to stopping.
cues.zh: 模型以 EOS 訓練時，就學會這個詞元代表停止。

cues.en: So the model sees the iOS token and it will stop generating new tokens thereafter.
cues.zh: 看到 EOS，就不再產生新詞元。

cues.en: Then I will show you how to tokenize a batch of multiple sentences with different lengths.
cues.zh: 接著展示如何一次對長度不同的多句斷詞。

cues.en: You can see that the output of the tokenizer is now no longer just a list of integers, but instead is a dictionary with several keys.
cues.zh: tokenizer 輸出不再只是整數串列，而是有幾個鍵的字典。

cues.en: I will discuss this in more detail when I switch to code, but I think when you look at the attention
cues.zh: 切到程式碼會詳談，但看這裡的注意力

cues.en: mask here, you can already guess that this will correspond to the valid tokens that the model should pay attention to.
cues.zh: 遮罩，應已猜到它對應模型應關注的有效詞元。

cues.en: Then I will show you how to fully parameterize a call to the generate class.
cues.zh: 再展示 generate 呼叫的完整參數設定。

cues.en: Now, I've already discussed some of these options in the past few videos.
so this will be a little bit of a reminder and also some new information.
cues.zh: 這裡有回顧，也有新資訊。

cues.en: Keep in mind that you do not always need to input all of these parameters.
cues.zh: 不一定每次都要傳全部參數。

cues.en: I'm just showing them here so you get a sense of what the options are.
And at the end of the code demo, I will also show you a very simple syntax that you can use, which sometimes generates warnings, but most of the time you don't need to worry about them.
cues.zh: 示範最後也會給非常簡單的語法，有時會警告，但大部分時候不用擔心。

cues.en: All right, let's switch to Python.
So here we only need torch.
We need the Transformers library from hugging face, and from which we will get the tokenizer and the pre-trained model for GPT two.
cues.zh: 還有 Hugging Face 的 transformers，取得 GPT-2 tokenizer 與預訓練模型。

cues.en: And that's what I'm inputting here.
Or importing over here.
Okay.
So then you can see here I'm printing out tokenizer pad token and also tokenizer.
cues.zh: 印出 tokenizer.pad_token，以及 tokenizer 的 EOS。

cues.en: Again this is for end of sequence.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，代表序列結束。

cues.en: And as I mentioned it's common to set the pad token to be the end of sequence token.
cues.zh: 如前所述，常把 pad token 設成 EOS。

cues.en: Now, this can sometimes cause some problems with training, because whenever the model sees the EOS
cues.zh: 有時訓練可能有問題，因為 EOS

cues.en: token that is typically associated with the end of a text, the end of a website, the end of an email, the end of a document.
cues.zh: 通常關聯文字、網站、郵件、文件的結尾。

cues.en: So when you put the.
When you use the EOS token as the pad token, that runs a bit of a risk of confusing the model a little
cues.zh: 把 EOS 用作填補，可能讓模型稍微混淆，

cues.en: bit to think that there are multiple end of text sequences.
cues.zh: 以為有多個文字結束序列。

cues.en: Now for training, this is generally not a problem, because when you are pre-training a model and when
cues.zh: 訓練通常不太有問題，因為預訓練、

cues.en: you're fine tuning a model, you are often using very long texts that get concatenated or truncated
cues.zh: 微調時，常把長文字串接、截斷，

cues.en: into smaller sequences of identical length.
cues.zh: 切成長度相同的小序列。

cues.en: So during the training, it's actually not so big of a deal.
cues.zh: 所以訓練時不是大問題。

cues.en: And then during evaluation, it's generally fine because these padding tokens go at the end.
cues.zh: 評估也通常可以，因為填補放在末尾。

cues.en: So basically the model is just going to see multiple EOS tokens.
cues.zh: 模型只是看到多個 EOS。

cues.en: But also that doesn't really matter so much because of the attention mask that I will explain in a moment.
cues.zh: 而且由於稍後解釋的注意力遮罩，也沒那麼重要。

cues.en: Okay.
So let's have a look at this.
So we can see this line of code is states that the Pad token is set to none.
cues.zh: 這行指出 pad token 為 None。

cues.en: And here you can see the EOS token is end of text or end of sequence.
cues.zh: EOS 是文字結束、序列結束詞元。

cues.en: Okay.
And then yeah we define the pad token here I'm redefining it to be instead of none.
cues.zh: 這裡重新定義填補詞元，不再 None。

cues.en: It's going to be the end of text token.
That is fine.
Uh, there are other times when you might want to set this to be a space or maybe a tab, but, uh,
it's fairly common to set this pad token to be the EOS token.
Okay, so now here we have an interesting situation where I want to encode or tokenize these three statements,
cues.zh: 現在想對這三段話編碼、斷詞，

cues.en: these three sequences of text, they are different numbers of characters, different numbers of words.
That does not trivially mean that they will be different numbers of tokens.
cues.zh: 不一定直接代表詞元數不同。

cues.en: But it's a pretty safe bet that these three sentences will correspond to three different lengths of tokens.
cues.zh: 但這三句對應三種詞元長度，是相當合理的猜測。

cues.en: So therefore we can write padding equals true.
And notice what that gives us here in the output.
So this is the token sequence for the first sentence.
And you can see that these are the tokens that correspond to the text.
And here we have the padding tokens over here.
And then also the same for the third sentence there are two Pad tokens here.
cues.zh: 第三句同樣有兩個 pad token。

cues.en: And the middle one that's the longest one.
That's every unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.
cues.zh: 是「Every unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.」，不幸的家庭各有各的不幸。

cues.en: And that has no padding in it.
No padding tokens because that's the longest.
So basically the tokenizer looked through these three statements, these three sequences figured out
cues.zh: tokenizer 查看三段序列，判定

cues.en: that this was the longest one, and then padded the other two so that they all have the same length.
cues.zh: 這句最長，再填補另外兩句，讓長度相同。

cues.en: Okay, so that is the key input IDs.
So input token IDs.
And there's one of those for each of the elements in this list up here.
cues.zh: 上面串列的每個元素，各對應一份。

cues.en: Okay.
And then we have this other thing here called attention mask.
And when you look at these numbers I think that's pretty obvious what this is.
This is ones for all of the valid tokens that really correspond to the text.
cues.zh: 真正對應文字的有效詞元，全是 1。

cues.en: And it is zeros for the tokens that do not appear in the text but are just filled in to some default value.
cues.zh: 不是文字，只是填入預設值的詞元，則是零。

cues.en: Okay.
And then internally, the hugging face models, uh, are programmed to avoid processing these tokens here that have an attention mask of zero.
cues.zh: Hugging Face 模型內部，會避免處理 attention_mask 為零的那些詞元。

cues.en: All right.
So now what I'm going to do is basically just print out all of this information in a way that's a little bit easier to look at.
cues.zh: 現在把資訊用比較容易看的方式印出。

cues.en: So every happy family is the same.
And that has these tokens and this attention mask.
cues.zh: 對應這些詞元、這個注意力遮罩。

cues.en: Every unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.
And why did the chicken cross the road?
I don't know how these three sentences are connected.
cues.zh: 不知道三句怎麼連起來。

cues.en: Actually, these two are.
And if you don't know this, it's a famous opening of a famous book.
cues.zh: 不知道的話，它們來自一本名著的著名開頭。

cues.en: And I will leave it to you to figure out what that is.
Okay, so now what I'm going to show you is generating some text.
So in the previous section we were just generating text kind of on the fly.
Not not super duper careful about it.
And basically we were just, you know, doing something like this.
We were just saying model dot generate and then the tokens, that was basically all this generate method in hugging face models has a lot of additional options.
cues.zh: 只寫 model.generate，再傳詞元；其實 Hugging Face 的 generate 還有很多選項。

cues.en: So we have input IDs.
That is how we've been using it so far.
Attention mask.
Now this line you do not necessarily need unless you have multiple inputs with different sequence lengths.
cues.zh: 除非多個輸入的序列長度不同，不一定需要這行。

cues.en: So so only sometimes you need to worry about this.
You can explicitly specify the padding token the maximum length.
cues.zh: 可明確指定填補詞元、最大長度。

cues.en: Now this is the maximum length of the output which includes the input.
cues.zh: 最大輸出長度包含輸入。

cues.en: And also keep in mind that this parameter here max length does not mean that the output will necessarily be exactly 66 tokens long.
cues.zh: max_length 不代表輸出一定恰好 66 個詞元。

cues.en: The model may stop earlier if it has decided that it has completed its thought, and it generates an end of sequence token on its own.
cues.zh: 模型可能覺得已完成想法，自行生成 EOS，提早停。

cues.en: So this is the maximum possible length.
cues.zh: 所以只是最大可能長度。

cues.en: That doesn't mean that the output sequence will be this long.
Uh, yeah.
And then we just want one sequence back.
Do sample this you've seen before.
This will trigger the model to probabilistically select not just the largest token or the token with
cues.zh: 讓模型不是只挑最大、最高 logit 的詞元，

cues.en: the highest logit, but probabilistically from among them.
cues.zh: 而是在其中依機率抽選。

cues.en: Here we have the top k, so we are going to select only amongst the top 50 logits.
cues.zh: top_k，只從最高 50 個 logit 選。

cues.en: And here is top p.
We are only going to select amongst the collection of tokens that together give a 95% probability.
cues.zh: 只從累積機率達 95% 的詞元集合選。

cues.en: As I mentioned in the slides, you do not necessarily need to include all of these inputs.
cues.zh: 如投影片所說，不必包括所有輸入。

cues.en: I rarely use these two.
I'm just including them here.
So you have an idea of what some of these options are.
Okay.
You're still going to get some other warning messages.
That's fairly common with the generate method.
But don't worry about it.
Okay.

You can see that we still get quite a lot of the padding tokens.
And this basically means that the model stopped generating text at this point.
cues.zh: 基本上表示模型到這裡就停止生成。

cues.en: So the model said, okay, I've generated enough text here and nothing else is going to be terribly interesting.
cues.zh: 模型說，好，文字夠了，後面不會太有趣。
